newsitem.title: UK: British CEO to head Dominion's Virginia Power.
newsitem.headline: British CEO to head Dominion's Virginia Power.

text.p: Britain's East Midlands Electricity said on Tuesday its chief executive Norman Askew had been elected president and chief executive officer of Virginia Power, the main subsidiary of U.S. group Dominion Resources Inc.
Dominion last year bought East Midlands in an agreed takeover worth around $2.15 billion.
In a joint statement, the companies said Askew would succeed James Rhodes at Virginia Power and start in August.

"Because the United Kingdom is much farther down the road to deregulation in the electric utility industry, Norman (Askew) brings the experience, reputation and intellectual capital needed to maintain and enhance Virginia Power's strong competitive advantages," said Thomas Capps, Dominion Resource's chief executive officer and president.
Robert Davies, currently finance director at East Midland, will become chief executive officer at the British group.
